(async()=>{const G=(await import('/js/flight/gtiles.js')).GT, E=await import('/js/core/engine.js'), THREE=await import('three'); const r=new THREE.Raycaster(); const out=[]; for (const [x,y] of [[0.5,-0.15],[0.75,-0.1],[-0.7,-0.5]]) { r.setFromCamera(new THREE.Vector2(x,y), E.camera); const hs=r.intersectObject(G.holder,true).filter(h=>{let o=h.object; while(o){ if(!o.visible) return false; o=o.parent;} return true;}); const h=hs[0]; if(!h){out.push(null); continue;} let tile=null; G.tiles.traverse(t=>{ if(tile) return true; const sc=t.cached&&t.cached.scene; if(sc){ let has=false; sc.traverse(o=>{if(o===h.object) has=true}); if(has) tile=t; } return false; }); out.push({ge: tile&&+tile.geometricError.toFixed(0), d: tile&&+(tile.__distanceFromCamera||0).toFixed(0)}); } return JSON.stringify({sinceHud: ((performance.now()-window.__th)/1000).toFixed(1), stats: G.tiles.stats, hits: out})})()
